# FG-CI-0020

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`ci-runner`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-runner.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_failed_artifact_upload_fails_the_job` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: CI のジョブの成果物を送れない、または受け取れませんでした。ジョブは失敗にしました。
- en: The CI job's artifacts could not be sent or received. The job was failed.
- id: Artefak tugas CI tidak dapat dikirim atau diterima. Tugas digagalkan.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C6: the runner moves artifacts with the job's own token — before the script it fetches the artifacts of the jobs it `needs` (`GET /api/v1/runner/jobs/{job_id}/needs/artifacts[/{id}]`) into the work tree, and after a successful script it uploads each file of its declared paths. One of these failed: the server answered an error (`server_code`, e.g. FG-CI-0004 when the job ended meanwhile, FG-REPO-0003 storage), the connection failed or timed out (`reason=send` / `receive`), the work tree could not be read (`reason=collect`), or a needed artifact could not be placed (`reason=path_invalid` / `path_exists` / `place`: a path is already in the checkout, or not a relative path). The job is reported failed so a later job never runs without what it needs.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The runner host (`journalctl -u forge-runner`, JSON) logs it once (warn) with `error_code`, `request_id`, `job_id`, `attempt`, `pipeline_id`, `reason`, `path`, `server_code`; the job's log ends with the same code. On forge: `forge.ci.artifact_stored` per stored file; SELECT id, path, size_bytes FROM forge.ci_artifacts WHERE job_id = <job_id>; `forge doctor` `repositories.storage` for the storage root.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-runner (Artifacts): fix the storage (free space under `<storage.root>/ci-artifacts`) or the network between the runner and forge, or move the conflicting path out of the repository, then retry the pipeline (gstn pipeline retry).
